sprint.title: Immediate Local Route Command Alignment
sprint.goal: For one immediate, named current-scene route, make move to <adjacent location> resolve to the already authoritative directional movement result.
acceptance_criteria: At the current scene, move to <adjacent location> succeeds only when that name identifies one immediately traversable connection and yields the same destination and movement behavior as the matching directional command.
Resolution is deterministic and restricted to current-scene immediate exits; non-adjacent, unavailable, ambiguous, or unrecognized names do not move the player or expose a route beyond the scene.
Existing structural connectivity and movement authority remain unchanged; the local name form reuses rather than duplicates movement resolution.
go to <destination> and head to <destination> do not become travel commands in this sprint.
No persistence, history, parser framework, provider behavior, migration, or save-version change is introduced.

staging_commands: Official-interpreter preflight through the established workspace procedure
focused_commands: Focused immediate local route command-alignment tests
Affected interaction-kernel, navigation-projection, movement, save/load, narration-context, and provider-safe regressions

governance: This owner-authorized capability package is active; no following sprint is authorized or staged.
Simulation retains authority over structural connectivity and movement; local route command resolution may use only immediate current-scene traversable connections.
Do not infer or expose nonlocal destination relationships, destination knowledge, or multi-step travel.
Do not generalize go to or head to commands into travel without separately staged bounded architecture authority. Save version remains 1.
Provider requests are forbidden for automated verification, and next_sprint remains null.
